scope: Bounded packed text/lines row loans feed the same emitted Mech scanner. A genuine full snapshot still supplies original producer admissions, Unicode fallback and final join in this qualification. No new resource, canonical partial Value, Rust workload body, or second runtime authority.
storage: The actual selected text/lines factory prepares one owning chunk store. UTF-8 payloads use packed allocations with four-byte newline offsets; cross-fragment lines grow amortized backing.

A synchronous row loan borrows that immutable store through row-table and reservation retirement. Explicit global first/count coordinates keep generated addresses inside the actual row allocation; no pointer is biased before its backing.
Only intersecting chunks are visited when building a bounded row table. The table does not grow with all previously retained lines, and directory search is not repeated for every row.

Metadata, payloads, replacement coexistence, framing and row loans use the original shared program/library account. One cumulative selected-producer allowance includes lookup work. The program meter already observes these debits; there is no duplicate charge or per-chunk refill.

Each loan binds to its exact selected producer and work ledger. Generated carrier instructions choose the monotonic lower bound or sealed returned range; Rust validates coordinates and owns/releases backing, without interpreting source states or headers.
Open retention clamps to completed input, permitting forward-jumping indices without reviving discarded data. Retention min/range calculations execute on the pause path, not the normal per-line path.
Only successful EOF publishes descriptive final geometry. Incomplete/failed storage never publishes a canonical String, Matrix, numeric length, output or permission.
